description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Range 30 feet

Choose up to three creatures you can see. Until the end of the encounter, the first healing Graft you apply to each of them restores an additional 2d8 Hit Points. You have decided the order, and your hands do not argue with it.

cinderfall.incomplete: This effect changes a different creature's own roll, HP, condition, or item, sourced from the card holder's own passive/item/action. No selector exists anywhere in pf2e-source for this -- confirmed corpus-wide this pass. This tags specific other creatures ahead of time for a delayed, per-creature healing bonus -- distinct from Suture Mastery's blanket self-passive because it names particular targets.
